data.theorem_title: Hadamard bound by Euclidean row norms
data.formal_statement: theorem matrix_det_norm_le_prod_row_l2 {idx : Type*} [Fintype idx] [DecidableEq idx] (A : Matrix idx idx Complex) : norm A.det <= Finset.prod Finset.univ (fun i : idx => Real.sqrt (Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun j : idx => norm (A i j) ^ 2))) := by sorry
data.natural_language_statement: For every finite square complex matrix, the absolute value of its determinant is at most the product of the Euclidean norms of its rows (Hadamard determinant inequality).
data.source: Hadamard determinant inequality, rowwise Euclidean norm form
